cues.en: Now, the next method that we are going to look at is front method.
Now we have mentioned that whenever we are calling the front method, it's just going to return the
front of the queue.
And it's not going to perform any operation on the queue.
It's not going to delete an element or insert an element.
Now we are going to declare the front method inside the queue class.
So here all we have to do is we are just going to access the zeroth index of the items that we have
in the queue.
So by accessing this element we are going to return this element from the front method.
So in this case if I call this method for this queue it's going to just return.
The ten and ten will remain in the queue over here.
So here after the queue method we are just going to write front.
And it's not going to take any parameter.
Then all it does is it's just going to return this dot items with the index of zero.
Because at the index of zero we have the first element in the queue.
So if I call it you will see that every time when we call this it's going to return ten.
So that's how the front method works.
Now the time and space complexity for this method is going to be one.
Because here when we are accessing the new element with the index, it's going to be one time complexity.
And the space complexity is also O one because an additional memory is not required over here.
